verdict.rationale: Mastra's first-party tools docs state that agents can load tools from remote MCP servers, which directly covers this story's core: an MCP-client capability that lets plugged-in servers supply tools. The evidence is a single sentence, though, with no detail on setup or supported transports. The MCP docs server and MCP server-authoring evidence describe server-side roles and are not credited here. Missing for 10: configuration/API details for the MCP client, explicit local (stdio) server support, tool discovery/filtering details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
